messages:
maria_cs: Starting NimblePay dedicated bring-up thread. Goal: validate quota, autoscale, and feedback capture. Go/no-go Friday 18:00 PST. Need owners for load test, telemetry, and customer enablement.

sam_eng: I'll own the load script + ramp. Target steady 700 RPS, short spikes to 1300 for ~2 minutes. Will include prefix warm and KV prefill steps.

lee_sre: Autoscale suggestion: min_instances=2, max_instances=8, scale_metric=95th_latency, target=150ms, step=1, cooldown=90s. Recommend pre-warm hook and enable KV cache metrics.

noah_devops: I can reserve the slot Wed 03:00 UTC (customer Thu 19:00 JST). Preflight plan: `ri-cli quota check nimblepay`, reserve GPUs 4->6, and run network egress test.

arthur_cs: Customer flagged renewal sensitivity to 99.9% SLA; please capture 99th/99.9th in post-test. They also want a clear cost delta if we need 8 GPUs vs 4.

alice_pm: Canary plan: route 10% to quant_v2, monitor regressions for 30m, then ramp. Add a console feature flag and a dashboard tile for canary.

beth_support: I'll prepare a 3-question feedback form (latency acceptable?, any functional errors?, quality regressions?). Short link will be posted here.

sam_eng: Uploaded locust script to /ops/loadtests/nimblepay_locust.py and ramp profile nimblepay-700-1300.json. Script includes KV prefill task.

deploy-bot: warmup job queued: id=9124; action=prime-model-shards.

noah_devops: Preflight checks running: model artifact present, KMS keys ok, ip allowlist set. Health check: `curl -fsS https://internal.health/nimble | jq .ok` -> true.

lee_sre: I'll run a dry autoscale exercise in staging and post GPU/host utilization snapshot into this thread after.

maria_cs: Action items recap: @sam_eng load script + ramp, @lee_sre autoscale config + staging dry-run, @noah_devops reserve slot + prechecks, @beth_support survey + shortlink. Please ack.

sam_eng: Ack.

lee_sre: Ack, will post results.

noah_devops: Acked, slot reserved.

beth_support: Drafting survey now, will drop link by EOD.

deploy-bot: warmup job 9124 completed: primed 5/6 GPUs, avg prime time=6m.

maria_cs: Nice work. Keep this thread as the runbook record. After the 2hr soak paste latency percentiles, error taxonomy, any throttle events, and cost estimate for scale-up. Thanks :rocket:
